contexts.text: To leave father and mother () = to leave the internal man; for it is the internal man which conceives and bears the external.
(Jabal and Jubal were called fathers, as originators.)
From the house of thy father () = such interior things (as affections and scientifics).
Under Hereditary, see this reference. AC 1438. AC 1444.
That which a man derives from his father remains to eternity. AC 1444:2.
The Lord's first worship of His Father, from the Celestial of love. AC 1454.
How the Lord was instructed by His Father according to all order. Treated of.
The hereditary evil from the father is interior and remains to eternity; for it can never be eradicated. Such the Lord had not, because He was born from Jehovah the Father...
Whatever the Lord received from the Father was Jehovah in Him...

Man receives from his father all that is internal: the soul itself, or life, is from the father... In a word, the interior man, or spirit itself, is from the father; but the exterior man, or body itself, is from the mother: as everyone, may apprehend from the fact, that the soul itself is implanted by the father... and whatever is added afterwards is from the mother. AC 4963:3.
Thou shalt come to thy fathers in peace () = that nothing of goods and truths shall be injured... Fathers, here, = the same as daughters and sons together; (that is), goods and truths.
To come to their fathers = to pass from the life of the body into the life of the spirit. AC 3255.
The internal man with the Lord was Jehovah Himself, for He was conceived from Jehovah; and therefore He so often mentioned His Father...

In proportion as human offspring recede from the likeness of their father, they recede from the father... Hence it is that the love of a father towards his children is diminished according to their advance in age It was otherwise with the Lord...
Thou shalt be for a father of a multitude of nations () = the union of the Human essence with the Divine one... Father = from Himself; that is, from the Lord. AC 2005, Explained. AC 2011.
It is this reciprocal union which the Lord means when He attributes to the Father what belongs to Himself, and to Himself what belongs to the Father. Illustrated. AC 2025:4, Explained. AC 2026.
Hence it is evident that the Lord was not another than the Father, although He spoke of the Father as of another; and this by reason of the reciprocal union which was to be effected. Shown.
(Thus) in Heaven they know no other Father than the Lord; because the Father is in Him... and when they see Him, they see the Father. AC 2293. AC 2305. AC 7089.

The soul is from the father... The Lord's internal was from the Father, thus was the Father Himself. Hence He says that the Father is in Him; that I am in the Father, and the Father in Me; he that seeth Me, seeth the Father; that I and the Father are one...
Our father is old () = that it is no longer known what good is.
Unless it had been said that they should adore the Father, although there is no access to Him except through the Son... it would not have been received.
She is the daughter of my father, but not... of my mother () = that the Rational is conceived from celestial good as a father, but not from spiritual truth as a mother. Explained.
All the conception of doctrine is from good as a father, but it is born through truth as from a mother.
He thus became one with the Father.
Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, in the internal sense, are not three Gods, but one.

The reason the Son = Divine truth, and the Father Divine good, is that the union of the Divine essence with the Human one, and of the Human one with the Divine one, is the marriage of Divine good with truth, and of truth with good... Good itself is the Father, and truth itself is the Son; but as there is a Divine marriage of good and truth, and of truth and good, the Father is in the Son, and the Son in the Father. Illustrated.
Hence the Lord so often said that He went to the Father... Illustrated.
The house of my father () = the maternal Hereditary as to evil.
The communication of the Divine Itself which is the Father with the Divine Human which is the Son. Signified. AC 3285, Signified.
Internal good is called the father's house... All good and truth is born through the influx of internal good as a father, into external good as a mother.
Thou shalt go unto my father's house () = good which is from the Divine.
Fathers, with them, = goods.

Whatever is born derives its being from the father, and its manifesting from the mother... The Natural as to good is conceived from rational good as a father; and as to truth, is conceived from rational truth as a mother. AC 3677.
The conjunction of man with the Divine Itself which is called the Father, is through the Divine Human which is called the Son; thus through the Lord...

Every man receives domestic good from his father and from his mother, which goods are distinct from each other; that which he receives from the father is interior; and that from the mother is exterior. With the Lord, these goods were perfectly distinct, for the good which He had from the Father was Divine, but that from the mother was contaminated with hereditary evil. That good in the Natural which the Lord had from the Father was His proprium...
(So) the good which a man receives from the Lord as a new Father is interior...
Perhaps my father will feel me (); = the inmost degree of perception... Father = good; here, Divine.
The natural good of the Lord's infancy, which was Divine from the Father, but human from the mother...
Abraham = the Divine called the Father. AC 3673.
When being regenerated, they receive another Father...
The reason father = good, is that it is good from which are each and all things... Illustrated.

(Thus) good is as a father, and truth is as a mother; and therefore father = good; and mother, truth; and, in fact, the good and truth from which come lower or derived goods and truths... Illustrated.
In all these passages, father and mother = good and truth; and, in the supreme sense, the Lord as to Divine good and Divine truth.
To be called father on earth is not forbidden, but to acknowledge at heart any other father than the Lord.
The like is involved by what the Lord said to (him) who said, Suffer me to go and bury my father (). For a father on earth relatively to the Father in Heaven... is as a dead to a living one.
My father and my mother have forsaken me () = ... when man observes that of himself he cannot do anything good or know anything true.
Instead of thy fathers shall be thy sons () = that Divine truths shall be as Divine goods.
Fathers, here, () = the Ancient and Most Ancient Churches, which are so called from the love of good and truth in which they were...
(Thus) father, in the genuine sense, = good; and in the supreme sense, the Lord.
Father, in the opposite sense, = evil; and mother, falsity. Illustrated. AC 6306:3.
As priests represented the Lord as to Divine good, they were called fathers. Illustrated.
That the Lord is one with the Father. Illustrated.
The Father, here, = Divine good; and the Son, Divine truth; both in the Lord. (AC 3705:3.) From the Divine good, which is the Father, nothing can... go forth but... Divine truth, which is the Son.
The Father sending Him = that He proceeds from the Father.
They who are in Divine good are they who love; hence it is said that he shall be loved by the Father...
The Father having given = that it was from the Divine good which was His, thus from His Own. AC 3705:end.

I shall return in peace to the house of my father () = even to perfect union. The father's house, when predicated of the Lord, = the Divine itself in which the Lord was from His very conception; and to return to that house = to the Divine good itself, which is called the Father.

That He came forth from the Father = that the Divine Itself assumed the Human; that He came into the world = that He was as a man; and that He went to the Father = that He united the Human essence to the Divine essence. Illustrated.
Which was her father's () = from good as to origin. AC 3803.
The disciples could not but think that... God the Father was supreme in His kingdom, and the Son next to Him.

No one having seen the Father but He who is with the Father () = that Divine good can be acknowledged only by Divine truth... Hence the internal sense is, that no one can have celestial good unless he acknowledges the Lord.

(Thus) the Divine marriage itself of the Lord is not between good Divine and truth Divine in His Divine Human, but between the good of the Divine Human and the Divine Itself; that is, between the Son and the Father; for the good of the Divine Human is what is called the Son of God, and the Divine Itself, the Father. AC 3960:2.

See Divine Human. AC 6849:5. AC 10267. AC 10738:4. DLord 29. DLord 29:2. DLord 32:6. DLord 32:7. DLord 34:3. DLord 35. DP 262:4. DP 262:7. AR 613. AR 618:2. AR 618:end. TCR 73:3. TCR 98. TCR 98:2. TCR 112:4. TCR 154:6. TCR 538:2. SE 5244:2, etc.
Return to the Land of thy fathers () = that now He should betake Himself nearer to good Divine.
The God of my father hath been with me () = that all things which He had were from the Divine.
Father, here Laban, = mediate good. AC 4111. AC 4159.
Goods and truths acknowledge no Father but the Lord.
See Desire.
The God of my father, when predicated of the Lord, = the Divine as to good.

The God of their father () = from the supreme Divine... For father = good; and the Lord's Father, or the Father when mentioned by the Lord, = the Divine good which is in Him. The Divine good is the supreme Divine...
The hereditary evil from the father is interior... and cannot be easily eradicated. AC 4644:2.
But My father only () = that the Lord alone knows the state of the Church as to good and truth in special...
The good of the Church is the father; and the truth thence derived is the son: hence father = good: and son, truth. AC 4973:7.
Joseph brought to their father their evil report... Father, here, = the good of the Ancient Church. AC 4680. AC 4680:end.
The Lord is called their Father, because He leads them like a father; and this through truth into good...
Under Be, see this reference. AC 10738:3.
See Ancient Church. AC 6304. AC 6428. AC 6846.
To do the will of the Father, and to perfeci His work () = the Divine good in act...
All the house of my father () = the removal of hereditary evils.
To Jacob their father () = the good of natural truth.
Under Church, see this reference.
Israel their father said to them () = perception from spiritual good... He is called their father, because the truths which his sons represent are from this good as a father. AC 5680.
Thy servant our father hath peace () = that it is well with the good a quo.
That which gives essence is as a father... and that which gives clothing is as a mother...
He hath set me for a father to Pharaoh () = ... that from him, as from good, is the Natural.
Go up to my father () = to spiritual good (AC 6084. AC 6102. AC 6499. AC 6514.) ... How spiritual good is the father of the Celestial Internal. Explained.
Each of the fathers of the Israelitish nation worshipped his own god. Illustrated.
(Joseph said) to his father's house () = the perception of the goods there.
Both we, and also our fathers () = that it was so from the first goods.
In many places, fathers do not mean Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, but those who were of the Ancient Church who were in good. AC 6075, Illustrated. AC 6182.
Whoever loveth father and mother more than Me, is not worthy of Me () = the things which are proper to man from heredity.
No one in Hell acknowledges the Lord... but they are not unwilling to hear of the Father the Creator of the universe.

My father appeared to me in a dream. I said that after a son has become his own master, he ought not to acknowledge his father as his father, as before; for the reason he is to be acknowledged during education is that he is then in the place of the Lord... But when he becomes his own master... the Lord is his Father... SE 2821.
See Ask.
The things of the mind were called a house; the good reigning therein, the father; the truth adjoined to that good, the mother...

The inmost of life of every man, called the soul, is from the father; but that which clothes that inmost, called the body, is from the mother: the inmost of life, which is from the father, continually inflows and operates into the external which is from the mother, and endeavours to make it like itself, even in the womb... (So with the Lord.)
As (spiritual relationships) derive their origin from one Father, the Lord... they who come into Heaven acknowledge no longer any brother, nor even mother and father, except from good and truth...
The Lord Knows all in the universe, but not as a Father His sons, except those who are in the good of love and charity.
The God of your fathers = the Divine of the Ancient Church. AC 6884. AC 6957. AC 7649. AC 8055. AC 8270. AC 8652.
The reason the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit were spoken of, was that they might acknowledge the Lord, and also the Divine in Him...

The Divine truth proceeds from the Divine good as a Son from a Father. When the Lord was in the world, He made His Human Divine truth, and then called the Divine good, which is Jehovah, His Father... AC 8573:end. AC 8705:3. AC 8724.
House of fathers () = the good of one family distinct from the good of another.
Fathers () = those who are in good and truth.

The Father in the Heavens = the Divine in Heaven, thus the good from which Heaven is. Regarded in itself, the Divine is above the Heavens; but the Divine in the Heavens is the good which is in the truth that proceeds from the Divine. This is meant by the Father in the Heavens. Illustrated. AC 9950:end.
Father = the Church as to good.
Visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the sons = the prolification of falsity from evil thence.
In the proximate sense (these words mean) that evil increases with the fathers, and is thus transmitted hereditarily into the children... But in the spiritual sense fathers = evils. AC 8908:3.

Honour thy father and thy mother = love for good and truth; in the supreme sense, for the Lord and His Kingdom... The reason the Lord in the supreme sense is the Father, is that He gives new life to man...
He that smiteth his father and his mother () = to blaspheme the Lord and His Kingdom... In the relative sense, it = to blaspheme the good and truth of the Church.
He that curseth his father and his mother () = the complete denial of the Lord and His Kingdom by those who are of the Church; and thus the profanation of the good and truth of the Church.

If her father refuse to give her to him () = if interior good does not admit conjunction... Father = interior good, because from interior good as a father and from interior truth as a mother are conceived and born exterior truths and goods, called sons and daughters. 9199.
To uncover their father's nakednesses () = to reveal these evils from the Hereditary and from the Voluntary.
The invisible God is called the Father.
The Father = the Divine Itself which was in Him; and the Son = the Divine Human.
Father = the evil which is from the proprium of man.
Visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the sons, and upon the sons sons () = the rejection and damnation of evils and of the falsities thence in a long series.
For good is the father of truth, and evil is the father of falsity.
He had thought only of the Father...
He who is the father of the nation rules; under him the fathers of families; and under these the fathers of each house... The father of the nation acts from a more interior love...
As the Father is in the Lord, and the Father and the Lord are one... it is evident that the Lord is God. Illustrated. AC 10822.
Under Trinity, see this reference. DLord 46:2.
They who have acknowledged the Father alone, and have confirmed themselves in such a faith, are outside of Heaven... HH 6.
All infants... are initiated into the acknowledgement and faith that the Lord is their Father...
b. Mother and father = the truth conjoined with good which procreates.
I saw a father speaking to six sons...
Everyone has interior evils from the father, and exterior ones from the mother. References.
The Father and the Lord () = Heaven.
That He was sent by the Father means that He was conceived by Jehovah the Father. Illustrated.
In these passages, and in all others where the Father is mentioned, is meant the Divine which was in the Lord from conception...
When in the state of humiliation, He prayed to the Father as another than Himself; but in the state of glorification, He spoke to the Father as to Himself. Illustrated.

In the commandment Honour thy father and thy mother, a man by father and mother understands his father and mother on earth, and all who are in the place of father and mother... But a spiritual Angel by father understands the Lord, and by mother the Church... And a celestial Angel by father understands the Lord's Divine love, and by mother His Divine wisdom. (Compare AE 1083:3.)
See Conceive.

Man derives evil from his father, from whom he has his soul... For the seed, which is from the father, is the first receptacle of life; but such a receptacle as it had been with the father; for it is in the form of his love...
If a man looks to God the Father only, he cannot be purified; nor if he looks to the Father for the sake of the Son. DP 231:6.
As He was conceived from God the Father... are not the Father and Himself one, as the soul and body are one?
The Divine Itself a quo is what is called the Father; the Divine Human is what is called the Son; and the proceeding Divine is what is called the Holy Spirit. TCR 172:3. AE 183:13.

The soul of everyone is from the father, and it is only clothed with a body from the mother. (Shown by the case of black children of a black father and a white mother; and vice versa.) CL 206, General article. TCR 92.

The seed is the first form of the love in which the father is; it is the form of his reigning love, with its nearest derivations... Hence, as a child grows... he comes... at last to his father's reigning love...

As every man is formed by the Lord in the womb in the image of God according to the likeness of God... it follows that the Lord is the heavenly Father of all men... and therefore He says, Call no man your father upon the earth, for One is your Father who is in the Heavens (); which means that He alone is the Father as to life, and that the earthly father is the father only as to the covering of life, which is the body; and therefore in Heaven no other Father is mentioned than the Lord.
To God and His Father () = thus images of His Divine wisdom, and of His Divine love. ( = the Divine truth, and the Divine good. AE 32.)
As I have received from My Father () = that they will have this from the Lord, who acquired all power over the Hells, while He was in the world, from the Divine which was in Himself. AE 178.

I will confess his name before the Father, and before His Angels () = that those will be received who are in Divine good and in Divine truths from the Lord; thus who have the life of Heaven in them... The Father = Divine good... from the Lord. AE 200.

In the (Gospels) the Father is very often mentioned by the Lord, and everywhere is meant Jehovah, from whom and in whom He was, and who was in Him... The Lord spoke of the Father, because by father, in the spiritual sense, is signified good; and by God the Father, the Divine good of the Divine love. The Angels never understand anything else by the Father when that name is read in the Word; nor can they understand anything else, because no one in the Heavens knows anyone as his father, from whom they are said to be born, and whose sons and heirs they are called, but the Lord. (CL 250:end.) This is meant by the Lord's words in . (Thus) to confess his name before the Father = that they will be received among those who are in Divine good from Him. AE 200.

As I sit with the Father in His throne () = as He and the Father are one, and are Heaven... For the unition of the Lord with the Father, that is, with His own Divine in Himself, had for its end that man might be conjoined with the Divine which is called the Father in the Lord; because it is impossible for man to be conjoined with the Divine of the Father immediately, but mediately through His Divine Human. Signified.
It is otherwise with the Divine of the Father. This is not adjoined, but united, to the Lord's Human, as the soul is to its body. Signified.
(The notion that God the Father had fallen from grace towards mankind, refuted.)
It is presumption to climb up to God the Father...
The two things which are antagonistic to (the two essentials of the New Church): First, that not the Lord, but God the Father is to be approached.
From this it is evident why the men of the Church approach God the Father immediately.
(The futility of praying to God the Father, shown by experiment.) TCR 162.

Having His Father's name written in their foreheads () = the acknowledgement of the Divine and of the Divine Human of the Lord from love and faith with them. The name of the Father = the Lord as to the Divine a quo which is called the Father, and at the same time as to the Divine Human which is called the Son; because they are one Person, united like soul and body. Therefore, in Heaven, by God the Father is meant no other than the Lord; and, in the New Heaven, the Lord is also called the Father. The reason the name of the Father is here said to be in their foreheads, is also that the Divine good of the Lord's Divine love is meant by the Father...
Hence His Human is the Human of God the Father...
They answered, The words (of the Lord's prayer) are clear, that we must pray to God the Father...

(The Angels said) We in Heaven read that Prayer daily... and we do not think of God the Father, because He is invisible; but we think of Him in His Divine Human... and thus to us the Lord is the Father in Heaven. Illustrated. TCR 112:6.
His Divine Human is the name of the Father. And the Kingdom of the Father comes, when the Lord is immediately approached, and not at all when God the Father is immediately approached.
Only when the Lord as to the Divine Human is approached... can the Divine which is called the Father be approached. Illustrated.
That the Lord is called Father, and the Church, mother. Illustrated.
The father and mother whom a man is to leave = his proprium of will and proprium of understanding, (which are) to love himself and his own wisdom.
A father returns in likeness; if not in his sons, in his grandsons and great-grandsons.
The love of children, with the mother, is as the heart there; and the love towards them, with the father, is as the lungs there.
That this sphere affects... the mothers; and the... fathers from them.
Fathers who regarded little children with hatred; but who loved them to excess the moment they were made to believe that they were their own.
Therefore the Lord so often called Jehovah God His Father, and Jehovah God called Him His Son.
That by these acts the Lord united Himself to the Father, and the Father united Himself to Him. General article. TCR 105. TCR 110:4.
That the Father and the Son; that is, the Divine and the Human, are united in the Lord like soul and body... no.

After death every man lays aside the Natural which he took from his mother, and retains the Spiritual which he had from the father, together with a certain from the purest things of nature around it...

As a man's soul is the man himself... it is evident whence it is that the mind, animus, disposition, inclination, and affection of the father's love dwell in offspring after offspring... Hence many families, and even nations, are recognized from their first father... For in the seed... there is a graft or offset from the father's soul... which may be made either to the likeness of the father, or to the likeness of the mother, the father's image still remaining within it, which constantly endeavours to put itself forth... The reason the image of the father is in its fulness in the seed, is that the soul is spiritual...
Hence the Lord prayed to the Father... TCR 110:3, Explained.
What then is the Father but the Son, and what the Son but the Father? Signified.
That the Divine of the Father is of the Human of the Son, and the Human of the Son of the Divine of the Father. Signified.

(Thus) the Divine of the Father is the soul of the Son, and the Human of the Son is the body of the Father. Whence is the soul of a son but from the father? and whence is his body, but from the mother? It is said the Divine of the Father, and the Father Himself is meant...
God the Father can never be approached, nor can He approach any man...
That the Lord operates from Himself from the Father, and not the reverse. General article.
Spirits maintaining that God the Father, because He is invisible, is to be approached. (Their arguments.)
That the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit are the three essentials of one God, which make one, as the soul, body, and operation with man. General article. TCR 167.
Honour thy father and thy mother... General article.
In the spiritual sense, to honour the father and the mother = to reverence and love God and the Church. (Explained.)
In the celestial sense, by Father is meant our Lord Jesus Christ; and by mother, the communion of saints...
Hence the Lord created the sun, to be in the natural world as a father, the earth being as a mother. For the sun is as a common father, and the earth as a common mother...
Therefore they who approach Him, also approach the Father at the same time. TCR 538:end.
That there cannot be conjunction with God the Father, but with the Lord, and through Him with God the Father. General article.
Under Faith, see this reference.
God the Father in a Human form...
They first approach three gods; afterwards, the Father only; and at last no one.
That man is not to climb up some other way = not to God the Father, because He is invisible...
In the New Church, God the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit are acknowledged as one...
(Lot of those who acknowledge only God the Father.) SE 575.
A bed in which lay my father and I.
My father was often absent from home, and always returned in a state of delight...
I dreamed that my father fell into the water... The Word with me was represented by my father when in life.
The Father = good; the Son, truth; and the Holy Spirit, the good and truth proceeding from Him.
They acknowledge one God, but only the Father... The only idea they have of the Father is as of a universal infinite...
In three successive essentials, which are the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit...

In their prayers they make supplication to the Father... and speak to the Father, although they know that no one can come to the Father except through the Lord... and that the Father does not hear anyone except mediately through the Lord... SE 5378.
An old man... whom some believe to be God the Father.
They said that the Father has all Power... not acknowledging the Divine of the Lord except in so far as He receives from the Father... It was shown that they acknowledged nature for the Father.
1.2. That they who acknowledge the Father only, and pass by the Lord, are determined to the loves of the body and the world.
That all the evil are against the Lord... but are not against the Father. SE 5988:6.
They believe that the Father is the only God... and they see the Father on high; but they receive answers from a certain Spirit... who says he is God the Father.
25. They who worship the Father only, and think nothing of the Divine of the Lord, are in adultery as of a brother with a sister.
One who had impressed on himself... to imitate my father.
Therefore, when the Lord mentioned the Father, He meant His own Divine in Himself. Illustrated.
They pray to the Father... when yet no man or Angel can ever approach the. Father... for He is the invisible Divine, with Whom no one can be conjoined in faith and love... Illustrated.
(Thus) the Lord is rejected by those in the Church who approach the Father immediately...
They who have thought only of the Father... make a god for themselves of nature in its least parts...
Fathers = goods; sons = the truths thence.

The reason Father, when mentioned by the Lord, means the Divine good which is in the Lord and from the Lord, is that the Lord called His Father the Divine which was in Himself from conception, and which was the being of His life... Illustrated.
As the Lord is one with the Father, He says...

One reason among many why the Lord so often mentioned the Father as another, is that by the Father in the internal sense is meant the Divine good... Therefore the Father is mentioned in order that the Lord's Divine good may be perceived by the Angels...
That father = good. References.
That father = the Church as to good, thus the good of the Church; and mother, the Church as to truth, thus the truth of the Church. References.
I sit with My Father in His throne = the Divine good united to the Divine truth in Heaven...
Why the Lord spoke of His conjunction with men as of His conjunction with the Father.
The heat which proceeds from Him as a Sun is the Divine good; this is meant by the Father in the Heavens. Illustrated. AE 297.
That the Divine good is meant by the Father. Illustrated. AE 267:2. AE 295:3. AE 419:5. AE 907:2.
The Father judgeth no man... The Father = the Lord as to Divine good...
The Divine which the Lord called the Father was His own Divine... AE 309:end.
There is the Father; for the Father is in Him and He in the Father... Therefore they who pray to the Father... turn aside from the way...
The Father, here means the Divine Itself of the Lord which assumed the Human; for this Divine was in Him from conception; and because He was conceived from it, He called it the Father.
Father and mother = the Church as to good and truth.
Father = the Lord; and mother His Kingdom.
Fathers = those who were of the Ancient Church. AE 504:5.
The Father in the Heavens = the Divine in the Lord.
Before the Lord's advent, the Divine proceeded from His Divine which He called the Father...
The land which I have caused your fathers to inherit () = the Church which is in Knowledges and in the light of truth.
Father () = both those who are from Hell and those of that generation who had lived before, even from the earliest times. AE 589:2.
H. Father and mother = the Israelitish Church... The Church is called father from good, and mother from truth. AE 624:19.
The reigning affection with man is from his father... but with the Lord, the affection or soul from the Father was the Divine Itself, which is the Divine good of the Divine love.
The father against the son, and the son against the father () = evil against truth, and truth against evil. (Compare AE 532:11.)
To bewail her father and mother a month of days = that the evils and falsities of her religion are to lie buried in oblivion.
Fathers = those who are in the goods of the Church; here, those who are in evils. AE 617:30.
Therefore they are called the blessed of My Father. Father = the Divine good, from which are all things of Heaven. AE 600:9.

Call no man your father... Because father means the Lord, who creates and generates us anew... and therefore when a man is in a spiritual idea, he must think of the Lord alone as His Father and Master. It is otherwise when he is in a natural idea.
The Father in the Heavens = the proceeding Divine; for all who receive it are called the sons of their Father; that is, of the Lord.
Gathered to their fathers, etc. = to those who are like themselves.
To leave father and mother... = to leave that evil and falsity which a man has from his religion, and which defiles his understanding; thus from his father and mother.
All who constitute the dragon adore God the Father...
The procreating goods and truths... which are in the spiritual man, are as father and mother...
The love of self and the consequent love of the world are their father and mother (which they are to hate).
The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father = that evil will fight against truth, and truth against evil: the father. here, = the evil which is proper to man.
The fathers shall eat up the sons, and the sons the fathers () = that evils will destroy truths, and falsities goods.
Occurs.

As father = good, and the Father in the Heavens = the Divine good... for the sake of the spiritual sense in all things of the Word, it is said, that they were not to call their father on earth father... In the natural sense they may he called fathers, but representatively, namely... that the fathers of the world are indeed good, and lead their children to good; but not from themselves, but from the Lord. Hence it follows, that although they are called... fathers, still they are not... fathers, but the Lord alone.
It is never granted to any man of the Church to approach God the Father immediately...
Sight directed to the Father conjoins no one. Signified.
They who look to the Father, even if they acknowledge the Divine of the Lord, do not approach the latter...
The writings of the fathers.
The Father means the Lord as to the Divine Itself, which was His soul from the Father; the Son means the Divine Human; and the Holy Spirit means the proceeding Divine...

That when the Lord mentioned the Father He meant the Divine in Himself, thus Himself. (Thus) when the Lord mentioned the Father and Himself as two, He meant Himself by both; for the soul and the body are one... That the Divine which is called the Father was the Divine Itself of the Lord, from which His Human came forth, and from which it was made Divine. Illustrated.
The Father, here, means the Divine in the Lord, which was His life, as is the soul of the father in every man... consequently, the Father and the Son are one... as the soul and the body.

Here the Lord speaks of His Father as if He were another... Yet, lest they should believe that the Father and He are two, He says, the Father and I are one; and lest they should believe that they are one only by love, He adds, that ye may Know and believe that the Father is in Me, and I in the Father. (Thus) by the Father, the Lord meant Himself, or the Divine in Himself from conception; and by the Son whom the Father sent, He meant His Human; for this was sent into the world by being conceived from God the Father, and born from a virgin.

As the Father and He were one, and the Lord's Divine Human was from the Divine in Himself, all things of the Father were His, which is meant by the Father having given all things into His hands... By going out from the Father, and returning to the Father, is meant to be conceived and thus to come forth from Himself, and to be united to Himself, as the soul to the body.

It is here manifestly said that the Father and He are one; and that the union is like the union of the soul and the body; thus that it is such a union, that he who sees Him sees the Father... And as the union was of this character, and no one can approach a man's soul, but the man himself, He says that they were to go to Him, and were to ask the Father in His name...
As the Father and He were one, He says, All things which the Father hath are Mine... just as all things of the soul are of the man.
To ascend to his Father () = the unition of His Human with His Divine, when the human from the mother had been fully rejected.
The father of the family -the Lord as to truth from good; father, Himself as to good; and of the family, Himself as to truths.
Father, in the celestial sense, or the Heavenly Father, = the Lord.
That Father = the Lord as to Divine good. References.
They have not marriage love who approach the Father as a Person by Himself...
The Divine Itself from eternity is meant by the Father; the Divine Human born in time is meant by the Son of God; and the Divine which proceeds from both is meant by the Holy Spirit.
When He went to the Father, that is, when He became one with the Father...
Every man is rational from the soul which is from the father.
The affection itself which is of love is from the father; which, also, is the very life or soul of man; but the clothing is from the mother.
They who acknowledge the Father as separate and as the only one, worship nature.
For the sake of the internal sense, He named Divine good the Father.
Those within the Church who... acknowledge... only the Divine of the Father cannot be saved...
The Father = the Divine Itself; the Son, the Divine Human; and the Holy Spirit the proceeding Divine.
The Father and the Son are the Lord alone. He is so called because He was in the world in a state of union.
What does it matter, therefore, whether I think that the Divine of the Lord assumed (the Human), or that the Divine of the Father did so... Ath 141.

Was the Lord not from the Father (as well as from the mother)? Are not life and the first of life from the father, and its additions from the mother? To believe that the Lord was perfect Man from the mother alone, is entirely contrary to all order... Is not the image of the father in his children as much as that of the mother? The love itself or dominant affection of a father comes forth clearly in grandchildren and in families. In a word, there must be a father and a mother, for man to be a perfect man.
The Father never hears you... and by this faith no one is saved. They pass the Lord by and pray to the Father, which is altogether contrary to the Lord's commandment...
(Hence) the Lord so often said that the Father in Him doeth the works; but in other places, that He Himself doeth them.
(The papists) are accepted because they rarely worship the Father, or separate the Lord from the Father...
Hence they go to the Father... by which their thoughts ascend above the Lord...

There was a trial made, to see what kind of an idea they have when they are... asking the Father... They think of the Father, and of the Son as a common man... and wholly separate the Son from the Father, and place Him below... Quite contrary to the doctrine of Athanasius, that the Divine and the Human are one Person; thus that the Human also is with the Father, and one with the Father...

Many who think of God the Father have an indeterminate idea, and easily acknowledge nature as God; (therefore) in the other life, it is granted them to see some one on high... who calls himself God the Father...
The Divine which the Lord called the Father ... He thus spake from His Human...
When they are thinking of God the Father, it is some Spirit... that makes answer, and Hows into their thoughts.
He put on a Human from the Father. Ath 162.
Worshipping the Father only, induces a severe pain in the arm and shoulder blade.
Under Eternity, see this reference.
That the Lord is the Father. Illustrated. The Father can be in no other Human than that which is from Himself.

The Lord means His own Divine by the Father; this, therefore, assumed the Human; and therefore it is as His soul in the body; for the Father cannot be understood to have been a first Person; because so there would have been two Fathers.
They who look to the Father, turn in various directions...
They who separate from the Lord the Divine which is called the Father, and set the Divine of the Father outside the Human of the Lord, should be called Philippians, from Philip...

Mohammedans... have acknowledged the Father alone... Socinians do the same... Many others tacitly acknowledge the Father only... The greater part are there found to worship the Father only, or the Holy Spirit, and not the Lord.
The reason the Lord so often mentioned the Father. was that before His advent the Lord was Himself what is called the Father... But afterwards the Lord became the Father as to the Divine Human also.
Good proceeding is called by the Lord the Father in the Heavens...
When it is said that God the Father assumed the Human, it is perceived... as too exalted... Yet it is according to the faith... that the Lord's Divine is quite equal to the Divine of the Father...
That the Lord's Divine is what He calls the Father...
The Hells bitterly hate the Lord; not so the Father...
The reason the Lord so often said that the works which He does He does from the Father, was that they might believe in His Divine Itself, or that His Human was Divine...

Every man is called from his father... because the life of every man is from his father; and only the clothing is supplied in the mother... Why, therefore, is the Lord called the son of Mary, when it is known that His Father was His Divine?

What a man has from the father is the love itself, because this is the very life of man, and the body lives from it; thus the very life of a man is from his father, and nothing of life is from his mother. As, therefore, the very life was Divine, or Divine Love, and the body is only obedience, it clearly follows that the Lord as Man, is God.

The affection of every man, into which he is born, is from the father, because it is his soul... With the Lord alone there was good affection from birth, because His soul from the Father was the Divine Itself...
2. These first receptacles, which are the initiaments of man, are from the father; but their formation to the full is from the mother. Explained.

Redeemer. 9. 2. Hence the image of the father is implanted in the body, at first obscurely, but afterwards more and more evidently, as the child applies himself to the studies and offices of his father.
Redeemer. 9. 10. The reason why in this state He prayed to the Father, was that He was then as it were absent from Him.
Holy Spirit. 1. 7. As the Father is the soul and life of the Son; and the Son is the human body of the Father; and the Holy Spirit is the proceeding Divine; it follows that they are consubstantial...

Trinity. 2. 9. He who knows the intercourse of the soul and body, may comprehend... that the Father and He are one; that all things of the Father are His, and all His the Father's; that all things of the Father come to Him; that the Father has given all things into the hand of the Son; that as the Father works, so the Son works; that he who sees and knows the Son also sees and knows the Father; that they who are one in the Son, are one in the Father; that no one has seen the Father except the Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, and who has declared Him; that the Father is in the Son, and the Son in the Father; that no one comes to the Father except through the Son; that as the Father has life in Himself, so has He given to the Son to have life in Himself; and that in Jesus Christ dwells all the fulness of the Divinity bodily. The Son, here, means the Human of the Father, CanonsNC 40. Trinity 4. 6.
Trinity. 5. 3. (The doctrine of the Apostles', Nicene, and Athanasian creeds concerning the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, compared together.)
LIV. For the sake of conjunction with the Lord, and, through Him, with God the Father.
All good is conceived from the Lord as a Father; and is born from saving faith in Him as a mother.
If, therefore, anyone approaches the Father immediately, the Lord as it were stands at one side; and hence is unable to grant... redemption...
